prompt: A flat shares one recycling bin. Their effort fails because food-soiled packaging and mixed materials keep contaminating the whole load. What is the best first improvement?

options.text: Recycle more items, including anything that looks like plastic
Learn the local rules for what is accepted, rinse food off containers, and sort at the bin rather than guessing
Give up recycling, since one mistake ruins everything forever
Put recycling in the general bin when unsure, to be safe

explanation: Contamination is an information and routine problem, not an effort problem. Knowing the local accepted list and making clean sorting easy at the point of disposal fixes the actual failure point.
